title: Berkeley Housing & Address Database
description: Track 156 housing projects linked to 62,226 Berkeley addresses. Every street, every parcel, every project.
source: City of Berkeley, Alameda County GIS, Eric Gellerman's Berkeley Development Map

berkeley_housing_map.title: Housing Projects (156)
berkeley_housing_map.description: Active housing development projects with permits, units, and news coverage

projects_by_units.title: Projects by Units
projects_by_units.description: All projects sorted by unit count
projects_by_units.sql: SELECT address_display, net_units, status, data_source, latitude, longitude FROM projects ORDER BY net_units DESC

projects_with_news.title: Projects with News Coverage
projects_with_news.sql: SELECT address_display, net_units, status, primary_news_source FROM projects WHERE has_media_coverage = 1 ORDER BY net_units DESC

berkeley_address_centric.title: All Berkeley Addresses (62,226)
berkeley_address_centric.description: Every Berkeley address linked to housing activity

addresses.title: Master Address Table
addresses.description: 62,226 Berkeley addresses with APNs and coordinates

address_lookup.title: Address Lookup
address_lookup.sql: SELECT a.address_full, a.apn, a.zipcode, a.latitude, a.longitude, p.net_units, p.status FROM addresses a LEFT JOIN projects p ON a.address_id = p.address_id WHERE a.base_address LIKE '%' || :address || '%' LIMIT 100

addresses_by_zipcode.title: Addresses by Zipcode
addresses_by_zipcode.sql: SELECT zipcode, COUNT(*) as addresses, COUNT(DISTINCT street_name) as streets FROM addresses GROUP BY zipcode ORDER BY addresses DESC

parcels_without_projects.title: Addresses Without Projects
parcels_without_projects.description: Addresses that don't have housing projects (sample)
parcels_without_projects.sql: SELECT a.address_full, a.apn, a.street_name, a.zipcode FROM addresses a LEFT JOIN projects p ON a.address_id = p.address_id WHERE p.project_id IS NULL LIMIT 100
